description:
Register a new fertilizer product in the Ekylibre catalog. Navigate to the product nature variants management section (or use the provided starting page). Create a new variant with the following details:
- Name: 'Ammonitrate 33.5'
- Nature: Choose a suitable 'Fertilizer' or 'Nitrogen' nature (e.g., 'Engrais minéral', 'Matière', or similar depending on available options)
- Unit: 'Kilogram' (kg)

Ensure all required fields are filled and save the new product variant. It should appear in the product nature variants list upon completion.
